task: Make the bussin skillset proofs repeatable: structure test, CI on ubuntu and macOS, claude plugin eval trigger suite, README Tests and evals section

features.description: tests/skills-structure.test.sh exists in the plain-bash style of the existing tests and checks that every top-level bussin-* directory has a SKILL.md whose first line is ---, whose frontmatter name: equals the directory name, and whose frontmatter description: is non-empty. One ok/FAIL line per skill and check; exits non-zero on any FAIL. It takes an optional root directory argument (default: the repo containing the script) so the checks can be pointed at a fixture.
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh`: exit 0 and an ok line for the frontmatter, name and description check of each of the eight bussin-* skills. Write a fixture root in the scratchpad with bussin-good/SKILL.md (valid) and bussin-bad/SKILL.md whose name: is bussin-other, run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh <fixture>`: a FAIL line naming bussin-bad and a non-zero exit.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); structure test on repo: 24 ok, exit 0; scratchpad fixture bussin-good + bussin-bad(name: bussin-other): FAIL bussin-bad: name matches directory, exit 1; review subagent: spec/standards/lean clean

features.description: The structure test checks that every bussin-* directory is listed in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (plugins[].skills as ./bussin-x) and in the README 'Included skills' list, and that every entry in either list exists on disk.
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh`: exit 0 with ok lines for marketplace and README coverage in both directions. In a scratchpad fixture, list ./bussin-ghost in marketplace.json without a directory: FAIL naming bussin-ghost, non-zero exit.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); structure test on repo: 40 ok, exit 0; scratchpad fixture with ./bussin-ghost in marketplace.json: FAIL marketplace.json entry bussin-ghost exists on disk, exit 1; reverse fixture (README ghost, skill unlisted): 3 FAIL lines; review subagent: spec/standards/lean clean

features.description: The structure test checks that .claude-plugin/marketplace.json is valid JSON (with jq, already used by the existing tests).
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh`: ok line for marketplace JSON. In a scratchpad fixture with a trailing comma in marketplace.json: FAIL line for JSON validity, non-zero exit, and the run does not abort before printing the other checks.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); structure test on repo: ok marketplace.json is valid JSON, exit 0; scratchpad fixture with trailing comma in marketplace.json: FAIL marketplace.json is valid JSON, remaining checks still printed, exit 1; review subagent: spec/standards/lean clean

features.description: The structure test checks that every file under bussin-*/ and tests/ has a kebab-case lowercase file name (letters, digits, dots, hyphens), except SKILL.md.
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh`: ok line for file names. In a scratchpad fixture containing bussin-good/references/BadName.md and bussin-good/references/snake_case.md: FAIL naming both files, non-zero exit.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); structure test on repo: ok file names under bussin-*/ and tests/ are kebab-case, exit 0; scratchpad fixture with references/BadName.md and snake_case.md: both named as not kebab-case, FAIL, exit 1; .DS_Store-only fixture: ok; /nonexistent root: FAIL; review subagents: first flagged .DS_Store (fixed), second flagged silent pass on bad root and locale ranges (fixed), spec/lean clean

features.description: The structure test fails when any tracked file in the repo mentions a retired skill as a skill reference: bussin-code-feature, ts-feature-architecture, drizzle-data-access, edefy-ui anywhere, and the Pocock skills tdd, code-review, test-audit, retro only when used as a skill dependency (for example `/tdd`, `` `tdd` skill``, `invoke tdd`, `uses the code-review skill`). The test file itself is excluded so its own pattern list does not trip it.
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh` on the repo: ok line for retired names, even though the repo mentions retro.md and plain-English code review. In a scratchpad fixture, a SKILL.md that says 'invoke the `tdd` skill' and another that says 'see edefy-ui': FAIL naming both files, non-zero exit.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); structure test on repo: ok no references to retired skills, exit 0; scratchpad fixture with invoke the `tdd` skill and see edefy-ui: FAIL naming bussin-tdd/SKILL.md and bussin-edefy/SKILL.md, exit 1; negatives (retro.md, code review pass, test audit, tdd_mode, retrofit, mytdd skill, overuse tdd) not flagged; /tdd, uses the code-review skill, invoke tdd, load `test-audit` flagged; empty root ok; review subagents: 1st flagged xargs empty-input false FAIL (fixed), 2nd flagged missing left word boundary (fixed), 3rd clean incl. Ubuntu GNU run

features.description: Any real problem the structure test finds in the bussin-* skills, marketplace.json or README is fixed in the files themselves, not by loosening the test.
features.verify: Run `bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh` on the repo: exit 0. `git diff <config.base> -- 'bussin-*' .claude-plugin README.md` contains only fixes, each listed in .loop/progress.md with the FAIL line that forced it (or no diff at all when nothing was found).

evidence.ran: bash tests/skills-structure.test.sh: 59 ok, 0 FAIL, exit 0; bash .loop/verify.sh passed; git diff c253de1 -- bussin-* .claude-plugin README.md: empty (nothing to fix)

features.description: .github/workflows/test.yml runs every tests/*.test.sh on pull_request and on push to main, in a matrix over ubuntu-latest and macos-latest, using the runner's default bash (3.2 on macOS). Uses no secrets; every action is pinned to a full version tag (vX.Y.Z). No comments.
features.verify: Read the workflow: triggers pull_request and push with branches [main]; strategy.matrix.os is [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]; a step loops over tests/*.test.sh with bash and fails on the first failure; `grep -n secrets .github/workflows/test.yml` finds nothing; every `uses:` matches @vN.N.N; no line starts with #. `claude plugin validate --strict .` still passes.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); claude plugin validate --strict . passed; read workflow: pull_request + push [main], matrix [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest], loop runs each tests/*.test.sh with /bin/bash (system 3.2 on macOS, Homebrew bash 5 is first on PATH there) and exits on first failure; grep secrets: none; only uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2; no comment lines; review subagents: 1st flagged redundant shell: bash (removed), 2nd clean

features.description: evals/ holds one claude plugin eval case per positive prompt (8 cases, one per bussin skill) using the exact prompts from the task, each with a prompt.md (frontmatter max_turns >= 15 and allowed_tools that include Skill) and a grader that checks the named skill fired via the `tool_used: Skill` style grader. The case format follows `claude plugin eval --help` and `claude plugin eval init --bare <name> --eval-dir evals` output; where those are not enough, ask the claude-code-guide subagent about plugin eval case and grader format.
features.verify: List evals/: eight kebab-case case folders, one per bussin skill, each prompt.md containing the task's prompt verbatim and max_turns >= 15, each grader naming its skill. `claude plugin validate --strict .` passes.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass, structure test ok with evals/ present); claude plugin validate --strict . passed; evals/trigger-bussin-<skill>/ x8, prompts byte-exact to task, max_turns 20, allowed_tools [Read, Glob, Grep, Skill], graders type tool_used tool Skill input_match naming the skill; review subagent: spec/standards/lean clean

features.description: The cases for bussin-feature, bussin-ts-architecture, bussin-drizzle and bussin-ui run inside a minimal fixture project: package.json with next, drizzle-orm and typescript dependencies, and src/features/orders/order.schema.ts with a small Drizzle orders table. Use the eval tool's own fixture mechanism (not scaffold_script, which is off by default) and keep one shared fixture if the format allows it.
features.verify: Read the four case folders: each references or contains the fixture; the fixture package.json parses with jq and lists next, drizzle-orm and typescript; order.schema.ts defines an orders table with drizzle-orm. The other four positive cases do not use the fixture.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (all ok); jq on 4 fixture package.json lists next, drizzle-orm, typescript; claude plugin validate --strict . passed; claude plugin eval --case trigger-bussin-drizzle loaded case.yaml+add_dirs with no format error (score 0.00, plugin not resolved, F11)

features.description: Two negative cases where no bussin skill may fire: 'What does the git rebase --onto flag do?' and 'Rename the variable usr to user in utils.ts.' Each grader fails if any bussin-* skill is loaded. The rename case has a utils.ts to act on.
features.verify: Read both case folders: prompts verbatim, max_turns >= 15, graders assert no bussin-* Skill call. `claude plugin validate --strict .` passes.

evidence.ran: claude plugin validate --strict . passed; bash .loop/verify.sh (3 test files pass); read both case folders: prompts verbatim, max_turns 15, graders tool_used Skill input_match bussin- with min 0 max 0, rename case has fixture/utils.ts via case.yaml add_dirs; review subagent: spec/standards/lean clean

features.description: A single eval case runs end to end and reports a score.
features.verify: `claude plugin validate --strict .` passes. Run `claude plugin eval . --runs 1 --ablation none --no-publish --trust-plugin --case <the bussin-honest-feedback case>`: it completes without a format or loading error and prints a score. Record the score and the case name in evidence; a score below 1 is acceptable for this item as long as the run completed, but note it in progress.md.

evidence.ran: claude plugin validate --strict . (passed); claude plugin eval . --runs 1 --ablation none --no-publish --trust-plugin --case trigger-bussin-honest-feedback: plugin "bussin" 1.0.0 resolved, score 1.00 ($0.09); same with --case negative-git-rebase-onto: score 1.00 (Skill called 0x, expected 0..0); bash .loop/verify.sh passed

features.description: Frontmatter edge cases: a SKILL.md missing the leading ---, one with `description:` present but empty, one with name/description only appearing below the closing --- are all reported as FAIL; names and descriptions that are quoted or use YAML folded (>) or literal (|) blocks are accepted.

evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh passed; /bin/bash 3.2 tests/skills-structure.test.sh <scratchpad fixture> exit 1: FAIL for bussin-noopen (no leading ---), bussin-emptydesc, bussin-bodyonly (name/description below ---), bussin-nofile, plus bussin-emptyfold (description: | with no body) and bussin-emptyquoted (""); ok for bussin-quoted, bussin-folded (description: > next-line text), bussin-blankfirst; repo run exit 0
